items.title: Solutions
bullets: ==Technology integration== — digitised filing, hearings, case management
==Judicial oversight== retained, with clear guidelines to prevent excessive litigation

blocks.text: Tribunals were created to deliver swift and specialised justice — but when they start mimicking courts in delay and dependence, they lose their very purpose. Without true autonomy and reform, tribunals risk becoming just another clogged cog in the judicial machine.
